name: feishu
description: Connect Feishu to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Feishu MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Feishu to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with docs, messages, and groups using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Feishu workspace.
Find anything in Feishu that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review docs, messages, and groups in Feishu.
